title: HARP Scope
description: A single purpose-bound scope offered by a HARP service. Each scope ties an access grant to a purpose of use and the minimum data class needed to perform it.

name.description: Scope identifier in resource.area:action form, for example rcm.eligibility:read.

purpose.description: Purpose of use this scope is bound to.

phi.description: True if exercising this scope can touch protected health information. PHI scopes require a completed BAA acceptance before issuance.

min_necessary.description: Minimum-necessary data class or comma-separated classes this scope exposes, for example coverage, claim, or claim,clinical_excerpt.
